entries.def:
βρυγμός, -οῦ, ὁ 
(βρύχω), [in LXX: Pro.19.12 (נַהַם), Sir.51.3 * ;] 
a biting, a gnashing of teeth: Mat.8.12; 13.42, 50; 22.13; 24.51; 25.30, Luk.13.28.†
(AS)

βρύχω (Attic, βρύκω), 
[in LXX: Job.16.10(9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, Lam.2.16 (חרק)* ;] 
__1. to bite or eat greedily. 
__2. to gnash, grind, with the teeth: Act.7.54.
† (AS)

βρύω, poët., late prose and vernac., 
to be full to bursting; 
__1. of the earth producing vegetation. 
__2. Of plants putting forth buds. 
__3. Of springs, to gush with water: Jas.3.11.
† (AS)

βρῶμα, -τος, τό (cf. βιβρώσκω), 
[in LXX chiefly for אֹכֶל ;] 
food: Rom.14.15, 20 1Co.8.8, 13; 10.3; pl., Mat.14.15, Mrk.7.19, Luk.3.11; 9.13, 1Co.6.13, 1Ti.4.3, Heb.9.10; 13.9; trop., of spiritual food, Jhn.4.34, 1Co.3.2 (cf. βρῶσις).†
(AS)

βρώσιμος, -ον 
(βρῶσις), [in LXX: Lev.19.23, Neh.9.25, Ezk.47.12 (מַאֲכָל)* ;] 
eatable: Luk.24.41.†
(AS)

βρῶσις, -εως, ἡ (cf. βιβρώσκω), 
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of אכל ;] 
__1. eating: β. καὶ πόσις, Rom.14.17, Col.2.16 (see Lft., ICC, in l.); with genitive obj., 1Co.8.4 metaphorically, corrosion, rust: Mat.6.19, 20. 
__2. As also in cl. (Hom., al.) = βρῶμα, food: Jhn.6.27a, 2Co.9.10, Col.2.16 (EV, but see supr.). Heb.12.16 metaphorically, of spiritual nourishment, Jhn.4.32; 6.27b, 55.†
(AS)

βυθίζω 
(βυθός), [in LXX: 2Ma.12.4 * ;] 
trans., to cause to sink, to sink: metaphorically, εἰς ὄλεθρον, 1Ti.6.9 pass., to sink, intrans.: Luk.5.7.†
(AS)

βυθός, -οῦ, ὁ, 
[in LXX: Exo.15.5, Neh.9.11 (מְצוֹלָה), Psa.67 (68):22 68 (69):2, 15 106 (107):24 (מְצוּלָה)* ;] 
__1. the bottom. 
__2. the depth of the sea, the deep sea: 2Co.11.25.
† (AS)

βυρσεύς, -έως, ὁ (βύρσα, a hide), late form for βυρσοδέψης, 
a tanner: Act.9.43; 10.6, 32.†
(AS)

βύσσινος, -η, -ον 
(βύσσος), [in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ, etc. ;] 
made of βύσσος, fine linen: Rev.18.12, 16; 19.8, 14.†
(AS)
